expected_metadata.title: Signed impulse estimates and global smooth solutions for finite multispecies relativistic Vlasov-Maxwell
expected_metadata.description: This research note extends the signed-impulse argument of OpenAI family 362 to a fixed finite number of relativistic Vlasov-Maxwell species with positive masses and arbitrary real charges. It derives the exact source-receiver coefficient, positive mass-weighted energy, angular occupation and selected coefficient bounds, and one coupled momentum bootstrap. The stated global classical theorem assumes nonnegative smooth compact phase data and compatible Maxwell fields with bounded derivatives of all orders and finite energy. The one-species result and its analytic machinery are attributed to OpenAI; mass normalization and continuation are established kinetic theory. No firstness or full Lean-formalization claim is made. AI tools were used extensively in research, drafting and verification. The preprint has not undergone conventional human peer review or refereeing; automated adversarial audits are not human peer review. The universal geometric cancellation is inherited; the new contribution is its species-dependent coefficient transfer and coupled closure for distinct charge-to-mass ratios. Constants may depend on the fixed finite species list; no massless limit or noncompact momentum-tail extension is asserted.
